intro: Three ways to be photographed. Every collection includes pre-wedding consultation, a custom timeline, online gallery, and personal-use print rights.

tiers.name: Essential
tiers.best_for: Intimate ceremonies, courthouse weddings, micro-weddings of 30 or fewer guests.
included: Six hours of coverage on the wedding day
Online gallery for sharing and downloading

tiers.name: Signature
tiers.best_for: Full wedding days from getting-ready to first-dance, 60–150 guests.
included: Nine hours of coverage on the wedding day
Engagement session along 30A or your choice of Florida coast
Pre-wedding planning calls and venue walkthrough
Custom shooting timeline and shot list
Curated print-store with archival paper options

tiers.name: Heirloom
tiers.best_for: Multi-day celebrations, destination weekends, and couples who want every chapter held in print.
included: Twelve hours of coverage on the wedding day
Engagement session anywhere along the Gulf
addons: Album upgrade — leather, silk, linen options
Travel beyond Florida — quoted on request

footnote: Travel within the Florida Panhandle is included. Destination weddings outside Florida are quoted separately and require a 50% deposit.
